name: Zoom and Pan
description: Zoom and pan with the zoom, x and y given as expressions of the time (Ken Burns).

params.name: fps
params.description: Frame rate used to compute `on` (output frame number) from the time

params.name: zoom
params.description: Zoom, clipped to 1..10. iw, ih input size, ow, oh output size (pixels), time seconds, on frame number

params.name: x
params.description: Left edge of the shown area in input pixels, clipped to 0..iw-iw/zoom. Variables of `zoom` plus `zoom` (the value just computed)

params.name: y
params.description: Top edge of the shown area in input pixels, clipped to 0..ih-ih/zoom. Variables of `x` plus `x`
